about: Catalogue of the real games with an oddity the engine once got wrong (issue #546, B3 of the testing strategy #540). The games are the recordings of tests/recordings (not copied); this file says what is odd about each, from which incident, and the probe that keeps the oddity in the fixture. Read tests/fixtures/weird_games/README.md.

games.match: Recoletas Zamora - Mipelletymas B.F. León (LF Challenge 2026/27)

oddities.what: FEB answers nothing (a real 404) for a few polls in the middle of the match: the app must not update, nor repeat what it said (7 polls of 10 s; how many fall in the gap depends on the cadence)
the play-by-play goes about a minute behind the scoreboard (55 s at worst): the rules of recent actions wait
annotation errors of the feed (a rebound credited to a player of the other team, 10 flagged): the possession tracker marks them

games.match: Cultural y Deportiva Leonesa - Melilla Ciudad del Deporte (2.ª FEB)

oddities.what: the game of the 0.4.2 feedback (a streak across the 2nd quarter, the 2nd foul of A. Reyes) with its own package; its log is up to 26 s behind the scoreboard

games.match: Class Basquet Sant Antoni - CE Bàsquet Llíria (LF Challenge)

oddities.what: the teams of the report of #519 (a game that FEB logged late): the recording has the last quarter, with the log up to 37 s behind; also the game where the +/- of the engine differs from the PDF when a substitution and free throws share a second (#594)
5 annotation errors of the feed flagged by the possession tracker

games.match: Oktícket Círculo Gijón - Caja Rural RDL (2.ª FEB)

oddities.what: a game of the bug of the wrong package when switching match: its own package, polled by one engine; log up to 36 s behind
a recording compressed to 2410 s for a 2400-second game: the clock of the feed and the clock of the recorder differ

pending.what: Cultural - Oviedo (a closing line 'Fin del Cuarto 4' read as an overtime at 300x). The invariant of the duration is checked on every game here and in test_live_core_properties; the real game is not in the repository yet
Oses - Joventut (cold threes said right after a made one, the log 40 s behind)
a game whose table was corrected after the fact (header score different from the log's)
an overtime, a 0-0 by points format, FBCYL with the remaining clock (#370), ids that change between seasons
